name: Social
summary: Shares a published post, release or product to the site's social channels through Buffer, from its own admin page.
use_when: The site's people should post a new blog post, release or product to the site's LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon accounts
One Buffer account already holds the site's channels, or can: Buffer posts to each network for it
Whoever shares should pick the channels, edit the words and choose when it goes out, and see how each post stands
avoid_when: Posts should go out by themselves whenever something publishes
A post needs a picture or a video of its own (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest): 0.1.0 posts links
The site wants likes, clicks and other numbers back from the networks

permissions.description: Share the site's published content to its social channels through Buffer, see how each post stands, and take back one still waiting

settings.description: A Buffer access token saved in Settings, sealed; it wins over the host's BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN

env.name: BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: The Buffer account's access token, from publish.buffer.com's API settings, typed into the host's variables by the owner; one saved in Settings wins over it

env.name: SOCIAL_RATE_LIMIT
env.description: How many shares and channel checks a person may make, as count/period; 30/1h by default, under Buffer's own limit of 100 requests every 15 minutes
